parameters.name: xs
parameters.precondition: xs is a finite immutable OCaml list

result.postcondition: For xs = [x1; ...; xn], the result is [xn; ...; x1]; equality is exact sequence equality, so ordering and duplicate multiplicity are preserved under reversal.

necessary_type_declarations.role: Built-in finite immutable list representation used by the entrypoint.

necessary_type_declarations.synquid: data List a where Nil :: List a; Cons :: x:a -> xs:List a -> List a
necessary_type_declarations.role: Inductive source-level representation mechanically mapped to the OCaml list type.

synthesis_only_helpers.name: snoc
synthesis_only_helpers.synquid_signature: x:a -> xs:List a -> {List a | _v == snocSpec x xs}
synthesis_only_helpers.role: Internal helper hole; append one element to the end of a list. It is not a trusted primitive or required exported entrypoint.

logical.name: snocSpec
logical.role: Non-executable logical measure defining one-element end append.

logical.name: reverseSpec
logical.role: Non-executable logical measure defining exact sequence reversal.

determinism: Pure deterministic function: output depends only on xs; no effects, state, randomness, or exceptions are specified.
